title: Stop the OptiSweep System Using the System HMI API Screen (SYSTEM SHUTDOWN)
summary: Use the system HMI API screen to initiate SYSTEM SHUTDOWN and confirm the AGVs transition to a shutdown queue between sorts.
when_to_use: When you need to stop the OptiSweep system between sorts so AGVs move to a shutdown queue.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Navigate to the system HMI API screen and press SYSTEM SHUTDOWN; verify AGVs transition to the shutdown queue.
safety_notes: The system should be shutdown between sorts to allow AGVs to charge.
access_or_tools_needed: Tipper HMI / WebVisu / VISU (system HMI access)

access_required: Tipper HMI / WebVisu / VISU (system HMI access)
system_preconditions: Use this between sorts (shutdown between sorts to allow AGVs to charge).

visual_references.description: System API Controls screen showing the System section and the System Shutdown control; includes note that System Shutdown shuts down the system and sends AGVs to a shutdown queue.
Operator station main screen image used in the stopping procedure; includes the SYSTEM SHUTDOWN step context (navigate to system HMI API screen, press SYSTEM SHUTDOWN).

steps.title: Navigate to the system API screen on the system HMI
steps.purpose: Open the correct system control screen to initiate SYSTEM SHUTDOWN.
steps.instruction: On the system HMI, navigate to the system API screen.
steps.expected_result: The system API screen is open and ready for the SYSTEM SHUTDOWN action.
steps.healthy_condition: The system API screen is displayed with the System API controls available.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot locate the system API screen or the SYSTEM SHUTDOWN control is not accessible.

actions.label: Open system API screen
actions.exact_action: On the system HMI, navigate to the system API screen.

source_evidence.quote: On the system HMI, navigate to the system API screen...

steps.title: Press SYSTEM SHUTDOWN
steps.purpose: Initiate the system shutdown sequence that routes AGVs to the shutdown queue.
steps.instruction: Press SYSTEM SHUTDOWN on the system API screen.
steps.healthy_condition: The SYSTEM SHUTDOWN action is accepted by the system (shutdown sequence begins).
steps.failure_condition: SYSTEM SHUTDOWN does not initiate (no shutdown behavior follows).

source_evidence.quote: System Shutdown Shuts down the system. The AGVs go to a shutdown queue.

steps.title: Confirm AGVs transition to the shutdown queue
steps.purpose: Verify the shutdown outcome required for between-sorts operation.
steps.instruction: Observe that the AGVs go to a shutdown queue after SYSTEM SHUTDOWN.
steps.expected_result: AGVs are in a shutdown queue state.
steps.healthy_condition: AGVs transition into the shutdown queue after SYSTEM SHUTDOWN.
steps.failure_condition: AGVs do not transition to the shutdown queue after SYSTEM SHUTDOWN.

actions.label: Verify shutdown queue transition
actions.exact_action: Observe that the AGVs go to a shutdown queue.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if AGVs do not transition to the shutdown queue after SYSTEM SHUTDOWN.
